labels.name: type: bug
labels.description: Existing behavior is broken or regressed.

labels.name: type: feature
labels.description: New supported product capability.

labels.name: type: enhancement
labels.description: Improvement to an existing capability or UX.

labels.name: type: docs
labels.description: Documentation, examples or public contracts.

labels.name: type: refactor
labels.description: Structural maintenance without intended behavior change.

labels.name: type: security
labels.description: Security, permissions, supply-chain or compliance.

labels.name: type: chore
labels.description: Build, CI, dependencies or engineering maintenance.

labels.name: priority: p0-urgent
labels.description: Active outage, exploited risk or confirmed release-stopping incident; owner intervention.

labels.name: priority: p1-high
labels.description: High-impact active sprint or release prerequisite.

labels.name: priority: p2-medium
labels.description: Normal planned backlog work.

labels.name: priority: p3-low
labels.description: Low-impact work or optional refinement.

labels.name: status: needs-triage
labels.description: Submitted; awaits owner validation and source discovery.

labels.name: status: needs-info
labels.description: Waiting on reproducible evidence, details or owner decision.

labels.name: status: blocked
labels.description: Cannot proceed until a named dependency or decision resolves.

labels.name: status: ready
labels.description: Scoped, accepted and ready for implementation.

labels.name: status: in-progress
labels.description: Active implementation underway; not necessarily verified.

labels.name: scope: api

labels.name: scope: backend

labels.name: scope: frontend
labels.description: Browser UI, routing and interactive screens.

labels.name: scope: sdk
labels.description: SAM kernel, packages and SDK machinery.

labels.name: scope: cli
labels.description: User-facing CLI commands and workflows.

labels.name: scope: daemon
labels.description: Go agentsamd, terminal PTY and native runtime.

labels.name: scope: desktop
labels.description: Local Studio, native shell and device integrations.

labels.name: scope: infra
labels.description: Infrastructure, automation and developer tooling.

labels.name: scope: release

labels.name: scope: storage

labels.name: scope: media

labels.name: scope: ecommerce

labels.name: scope: work

labels.name: scope: docs
labels.description: Documentation, examples and discoverability.

labels.name: size: XS
labels.description: Small and bounded; likely under two hours (estimate only).

labels.name: size: S
labels.description: Typically about half a day (estimate only).

labels.name: size: M
labels.description: Typically one to two days (estimate only).

labels.name: size: L
labels.description: Typically three to five days (estimate only).

labels.name: size: XL
labels.description: Epic or multi-week outcome; split into verifiable tickets.

labels.name: good first issue
labels.description: Low-complexity work suitable for a new contributor.

labels.name: help wanted
labels.description: Maintainers are inviting external contributions.

labels.name: wontfix
labels.description: Closed with an explicit reason; intentionally not planned.

labels.name: duplicate
labels.description: Closed with a link to the canonical issue.
